entries.60e71c911ceb38ef: It has set a Medium-Term Management Plan 27-29 aimed at the fiscal year ending March 2029, and its vision is “Strategic Partner Supporting Customers’ Transformation Through Digital Innovation.” Aiming to strengthen earnings power through higher value added and productivity in its core businesses and to expand into the ＤＸ and consulting areas, it sets 5 company-wide strategies: upgrading and streamlining the services it provides, strengthening the Consulting Business, research and development of solutions, securing specialist personnel, and strengthening organizational capability. It states that it is moving from the profitability-improvement stage pursued under the previous medium-term management plan to a growth stage that goes beyond the framework of a system integrator.
